title: Three strangers
sentence: Add a stone well, a gate for travellers, a knight on guard by the well, a lantern spirit, and a sword and a lantern by the well.

requests.pick_words: The knight picks up the sword.
requests.give_words: The knight gives the sword to the traveller.
requests.receiver_pick_words: The traveller picks up the sword.

agent.name: Wanderer
agent.task: You are Wanderer. Enter the world Three strangers through its gate, then take your turns there: greet everyone, then speak with the knight and with the lantern spirit by name.
